courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 阿斯旺高壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「堆石濕陷與水位」與「廣域湖面與庫容」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；阿斯旺高壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Rockfill wetting and settlement" and "Broad lake surface and storage" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Aswan High Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以阿科松博土石壩廣域湖泊與發電放流界面學習；阿斯旺高壩則以以阿斯旺長期蓄水調節串連土石壩與尼羅河水量為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on studying Akosombo embankment lake storage and generation-release interfaces; Aswan High Dam centres on connecting Aswan long-term storage with embankment behavior and Nile water accounting, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「堆石濕陷與水位」與「跨季庫容水量帳」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到阿斯旺高壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「淤積量與乾密度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rockfill wetting and settlement” and “Seasonal reservoir water balance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aswan High Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sediment storage and dry density", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 升降式水閘門吊裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「堆石濕陷與水位」與「廣域湖面與庫容」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；升降式水閘門吊裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Rockfill wetting and settlement" and "Broad lake surface and storage" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Vertical-lift water-gate erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以阿科松博土石壩廣域湖泊與發電放流界面學習；升降式水閘門吊裝則以以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on studying Akosombo embankment lake storage and generation-release interfaces; Vertical-lift water-gate erection centres on erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「堆石濕陷與水位」與「矩形門葉靜水力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到升降式水閘門吊裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鋼索彈性與行程」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rockfill wetting and settlement” and “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Vertical-lift water-gate erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rope elasticity and travel", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 阿科松博水壩
history.text: 阿科松博壩位於迦納伏爾塔河，業主確認其為堆石壩，原工程建設期為1961至1965年，電廠頁面列示裝置容量1020MW。本課將堆石與過渡層變形、廣域湖泊蓄水及發電放流時序連結，讓容量數字回到水量與設備限制的脈絡。業主同頁對壩高及壩頂長度存在互相不一致的敘述，因此不採用那些尺寸，也不以單一容量推定年度發電。所有單元幾何、流量與效率為教學假設，不能當成阿科松博實際工況或核准操作程序。
history.textEn: Akosombo stands on Ghana’s Volta River. The owner confirms rockfill construction during1961–1965 and lists1020MW for the plant. This course connects embankment transitions, broad-lake storage and generation-release timing. Conflicting height and crest-length statements on the owner page are excluded, and installed capacity does not determine annual energy. Every lesson geometry, flow and efficiency is hypothetical rather than an Akosombo operating condition or approved procedure.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「堆石濕陷與水位」到「枯水容量與年能量」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Rockfill wetting and settlement" through "Drought capacity and annual energy" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
